text: School name: schools.School, frpm."School Name", satscores.sname. Rows link by schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds.
satscores.rtype 'S' = a school row; 'D' = a district-level row whose sname is NULL and whose cds ends in '0000000'.
Excellence rate = satscores.NumGE1500 / satscores.NumTstTakr (share of SAT takers scoring 1500 or more).
Eligible free rate = frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)"; eligible FRPM rate = "FRPM Count (K-12)" / "Enrollment (K-12)" (same for the Ages 5-17 columns).
frpm."Percent (%) Eligible Free ..." and "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM ..." are fractions from 0 to 1, not 0-100. frpm covers only "Academic Year" '2014-2015'.
Enrollment for grades 1 through 12 (K-12) is frpm."Enrollment (K-12)"; satscores.enroll12 is a separate SAT-file figure that exists only for schools in satscores.
frpm has only (K-12) and (Ages 5-17) enrollment and meal columns; questions that say 'ages 15-17' refer to the (Ages 5-17) columns.
schools.Virtual: 'F' = exclusively virtual (no physical building), 'N' = not virtual, 'P' = partial virtual; 'V' and 'C' are defined but do not occur.
Charter flag is 1 = charter, 0 = not: schools.Charter and frpm."Charter School (Y/N)". schools.Magnet is likewise 1 = magnet, 0 = not.
Funding type values: 'Directly funded', 'Locally funded', 'Not in CS funding model' (schools.FundingType, frpm."Charter Funding Type"); NULL for non-charter schools.
schools.StatusType is 'Active', 'Closed', 'Merged' or 'Pending'; schools lists closed and merged schools as well as active ones.
Physical address: schools.Street (StreetAbr abbreviated), City, Zip, State. Mailing/postal address: schools.MailStreet (MailStrAbr), MailCity, MailZip, MailState.
Administrator names: AdmFName1/AdmLName1 (first/last), with up to two more administrators in AdmFName2/AdmLName2 and AdmFName3/AdmLName3.

schools.DOC (district ownership code): '00' County Office of Education, '52' Elementary School District, '54' Unified, '56' High School District; schools.DOCType and frpm."District Type" hold the text.

School type text: schools.SOCType = frpm."School Type", e.g. 'High Schools (Public)' (SOC '66'), 'Elementary Schools (Public)' ('60'), 'K-12 Schools (Public)' ('65'), 'Continuation High Schools' ('68').
schools.EdOpsCode short codes (e.g. 'TRAD' Traditional, 'CON' Continuation School, 'JUV' Juvenile Court School, 'SPEC' Special Education School); text is EdOpsName = frpm."Educational Option Type".
schools.EILCode (instruction level): 'ELEM' Elementary, 'HS' High School, 'INTMIDJR' Intermediate/Middle/Junior High, 'ELEMHIGH' Elementary-High Combination, 'A' Adult, 'PS' Preschool, 'UG' Ungraded.
County values are bare names without 'County' (e.g. 'Alameda', 'San Diego') in schools.County, frpm."County Name" and satscores.cname.
